required_new_input_groups.description: Target name, scope, as-of date, financial reporting currency, acquired entities and closing assumption
Site ID/address; fee owned, leased or supply only; who owns tanks; brand; contract term; assignment and conversion rights
Annual gallons, fuel GP, merchandise GP, rent and ancillary profit, dealer compensation, card expense, site cost and lease expense by site
Dealer commission, who retains merchandise and other income, dealer rent, site/lease/property/environmental cost responsibility, retained staffing
Dealer income and inside GP less dealer-paid labor, utilities, rent and other costs; minimum sustainable economics supplied by user
Incremental rate by eligible gallon/account; freight and rack; rebates; fees; rates already in baseline; overlap exclusions
Each function/account removed, retained/stranded, replacement cost, implementation date and evidence
Brand conversion; BP or other contractual repayments as documented; severance; IT; environmental; additional real-estate purchase; working capital
Price, fees, capex by year, taxes if applicable, working capital, residual/exit assumption, hurdle rate and timing
Cash/debt/equity mix, assumed debt and leases, financing cost, debt service, pro forma leverage and coverage definitions
Every input source/period/unit/status and specific missing items; separate verified fact, management estimate and user assumption
